skill.description: Use this skill to write clear prose for documentation, commit messages, UI text, reports, and explanations. It applies Strunk-style rules and avoids common AI writing patterns.
skill.summary: Helps edit human-facing prose for clarity, concision, and plain language.

content.value_statement: AI-assisted drafts often become vague, padded, or promotional. This skill applies Strunk-based rules and AI-pattern checks to make prose direct.
actual_capabilities: Applies active voice, positive form, concrete language, and concision rules.
Rewrites verbose documentation, commit messages, reports, and UI text.
Flags common AI-writing patterns such as puffery and promotional adjectives.
Uses targeted reference files for grammar, composition, formatting, and word choice.
Supports Claude, Codex, and Claude Code workflows through a Markdown skill definition.
limitations: Does not fact-check technical claims, sources, or citations.
Does not enforce a team style guide unless the user provides it.
Some historical Strunk guidance may need modern judgment.
Long reference files should be loaded only when needed.

use_cases.title: Tighten Developer Documentation
use_cases.description: Rewrite setup notes, README sections, and API explanations so users can scan and act quickly.

use_cases.title: Improve Product Copy
use_cases.description: Convert vague feature descriptions into specific user-facing text for interfaces, help panels, and release notes.

use_cases.title: Edit Operational Updates
use_cases.description: Make reports, summaries, and status updates shorter, clearer, and easier for stakeholders to understand.

prompt_templates.title: Basic Clarity Edit
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when you have a short draft and want a cleaner version.
prompt_templates.prompt: Edit this text for clarity and concision. Keep the meaning, remove filler, and explain the main changes: [paste text].

prompt_templates.title: Documentation Rewrite
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when writing or revising technical documentation.
prompt_templates.prompt: Rewrite this documentation for a technical reader. Use active voice, concrete terms, and short paragraphs: [paste draft].

prompt_templates.title: AI Pattern Cleanup
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when text sounds generic or promotional.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this draft for common AI-writing patterns. Remove puffery, empty phrases, and excessive formatting: [paste text].

prompt_templates.title: Advanced Style Review
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when the output must match a role, audience, or team standard.
prompt_templates.prompt: Revise this text for the target audience and style constraints. List tradeoffs, preserve required terms, and provide the final version: [audience], [constraints], [text].

output_examples.input: This groundbreaking feature leverages cutting-edge technology to deliver a seamless experience.
output_examples.output: This feature updates the dashboard in real time.

output_examples.input: The configuration file is read by the application at startup.
output_examples.output: The application reads the configuration file at startup.

output_examples.input: It is important to note that the API might potentially return an error in certain situations.
output_examples.output: The API returns an error when the token expires.

best_practices: Give the skill the audience, purpose, and any required terms before editing.
Ask for both a revised version and a short explanation of important edits.
Load only the reference section needed for the writing problem.
anti_patterns: Do not ask for generic polish without explaining the reader and goal.
Do not keep promotional adjectives when specific facts would be clearer.
Do not apply old grammar rules when they conflict with inclusive or modern usage.

faq.question: What does this skill improve?
faq.answer: It improves human-facing prose such as documentation, commit messages, UI text, reports, and explanations.

faq.question: Does it only shorten text?
faq.answer: No. It removes needless words while preserving meaning, structure, and useful detail.

faq.question: Can it detect AI-sounding writing?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes guidance for spotting puffery, empty phrases, overused vocabulary, and excessive formatting.

faq.question: Does it fact-check claims?
faq.answer: No. It improves expression, but users must verify facts, links, citations, and technical accuracy.

faq.question: Which tools can use it?
faq.answer: The skill declares support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: When should I load reference files?
faq.answer: Load a reference file when a draft needs deeper grammar, composition, formatting, or word-choice guidance.
